value: At last the tempered blade is lowered into the Sunwell. Light passes through the old steel and the saronite taint is cleansed; the quest presents a purified Quel’Delar where the corrupted weapon had rested. The well does not erase Lana’Thel’s command, Thalorien’s sacrifice, or the peril of the halls. It changes what can be carried forward. A weapon once broken and then remade leaves the sacred waters with a new claim upon the living.
